answer: Rank identities by where a short random walk from honest seeds lands, not by raw connections. Run a few steps of a seed-rooted walk; probability mass escapes into a region only as fast as the sparse edges bridging it allow, so a sybil terrace hidden behind a low-conductance cut receives vanishingly little landing mass however densely its members link internally. Internal jade-polished edges don't help — they recycle mass among fakes, never importing it. The fable that more connections buys standing fails: standing is bounded by the bottleneck to the core, shared across the whole region.
